tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/queue-lanes.test.ts: while a summary job is running and has not finished, an index job enqueued after it runs to completion; the two lanes run at the same time and each runs its jobs one at a time in order; summary kinds go to the summary lane and every other kind to the index lane; a single-document job is placed ahead of a queued sweep and takeDocSummaryEdit removes and returns it; depth, isProcessing and depthForRepo span both lanes (depthForRepo counts a queued sweep but not a single-document job), codeIndexWorkFor reads the index lane only, laneStatus reports each lane; stop ends both lanes and start resolves

cases.title: an index job enqueued while a summary job is running completes before that summary job finishes
each lane runs its jobs one at a time in order, at the same time as the other lane, and every kind goes to its lane
a single-document job goes ahead of a queued sweep, after earlier single-document jobs, and takeDocSummaryEdit removes and returns it
depth, isProcessing and depthForRepo span both lanes, codeIndexWorkFor reads the index lane only, and laneStatus reports each lane
stop ends both lanes after their current jobs, and start resolves only then

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/queue-code-index-work.test.ts: the existing test asserts the order of the index lane's in-flight jobs only, independently of summary-lane interleaving, and stops once both lanes are empty
